exposure: open bilateral common iliac artery occlusion (CIAO)
endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA)
cohort: Women with extensive placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery
finding: Fluoroscopy-free REBOA for women with PAS is associated with improved vascular control, reduced perioperative blood loss, transfusion requirements, and hysterectomy rates, as well as shorter surgical times compared to bilateral CIAO.
